format.environment.at: the instant a deterministic verifier judges the bundle at; wall-clock verifiers are in-window for every accept vector until 2035.
format.expect.stage: op A only: `match` marks a record that validates (§6.4 step 1) but whose subject fails step 3; a runner that only validates records expects okay for it.
format.expect.verdict: accept | reject. For accept: email (grantor), grantee, holder (access-cert holder in P, login holder in A, empty when the login carried none), scopes (entries verbatim). For reject: reason_class is the expected class; runners compare verdicts, reason classes are informational.
format.known_findings: audit ids this vector is expected to expose today (see docs/security-audit-2026-11-ws2-conformance.md); runners carry their own expected-fail lists.
format.op: P = presentation (§6.1): `bundle` is access_cert~assertion~warrant~config_cert. A = admission (§6.4): `bundle` is warrant~config_cert and `subject` is the independently authenticated login to match (holder may be null); a vector without `subject` stops after record validation. T = discovery (§3): `bundle` is a `_browserid` TXT record value; accept carries the expected public_key and host.
